assay: whole-cell electrophysiology; blocker-sensitive current compared with Pdf-GAL4 Shaker RNAi
result_summary: Figure 1 reports 100 nM alpha-DTX; Figure 2 shows reduced blocker-sensitive current in l-LNv with matching Shaker RNAi. Exact control genotype and local dose-response remain unresolved.
decision_reason: Literature supports this native l-LNv current component; keep as pilot pending local potency, vehicle and off-target checks.
